items.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'
items.description: Kashkari sat down with CNBC's Steve Liesman for an exclusive conversation Wednesday night.

items.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
items.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

items.title: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline
items.description: Trump recently said he was "very seriously" considering a diesel export ban, despite warnings from the U.S. oil industry that doing so would raise prices.

items.title: Eli Lilly says closely watched combo obesity regimen boosts weight loss in mid-stage trial
items.description: Lilly said it plans to start Phase 3 trials on the combo regimen adding its amylin drug eloralintide to tirzepatide at the end of the year.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model
items.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Alphabet's most advanced model yet, with major coding, cybersecurity, and complex professional work improvements.

items.title: Trump's meeting with tech leaders leaves AI safety more unsettled than ever
items.description: Following Trump's lunch with artificial intelligence leaders at the White House, the industry remains largely unchanged on AI safety.

items.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
items.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

items.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
items.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance and right before the midterm elections.

items.title: Meta stock enjoys best month since 2022 on AI momentum
items.description: Meta stock had its best month in almost four years as investors cheer the social media giant's recent momentum in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to help Pentagon with warfare initiative, Hegseth says
items.description: Pete Hegseth, in remarks about the state of the military, announced a project led by two GOP-supporting tech executives to examine military capabilities.

items.title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raise questions amid massive growth
items.description: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

items.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
items.description: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

items.title: Sen. Hawley: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declined to testify at rogue AI hearing
items.description: A Senate subcommittee on Wednesday is examining rogue AI, after a series of AI cyberattacks and increasing warnings about the risks of the technology.

items.title: Grindr expands beyond dating with $250 million telehealth acquisition of PurposeMed
items.description: Grindr is buying PrEP provider Freddie for $250 million, expanding into healthcare and seeking to make HIV prevention more accessible to its users.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield is higher as traders look past inflation data, await jobs report
items.description: Treasury yields were lower on Wednesday following the release of lighter-than-expected U.S. inflation data.

items.title: Fed watchdog finds renovation failures, but no grounds for criminal referral
items.description: The long-awaited report by the Fed's inspector general said it found no reasonable grounds to believe federal criminal law had been violated.

items.title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
items.description: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash flow positive by 2027.

items.title: Why Jim Cramer isn't buying more Boeing despite its huge Navy contract win
items.description: Two main issues are holding him up.

items.title: Senators clinch construction permitting deal before election jet-set
items.description: A legislative deal to ease construction permitting sets up potential action in Congress when lawmakers return after the November election.

items.title: Senate Democrats sink 'toothless' stock trading ban, data center bill in last act before election recess
items.description: Two separate proposals to ban member stock trading while in office and address data center-related utility costs failed Wednesday amid Democratic opposition.
